name: serpapi_google_local_services
description: Find screened professional service providers in Google Local Services Ads through SerpApi. Use for phrases such as 'Google Guaranteed plumber', 'screened electrician', 'car repair shop', 'house cleaner', 'local service professional', 'book a nearby contractor', or verified home-service businesses. Returns ratings, reviews, phone numbers, Google badges, service areas, years in business, availability, booking activity, provider IDs, public profiles, and focused provider details. This engine supports US locations only. An explicit data_cid uses one SerpApi search; New York, Austin, and Portland aliases also use one search; other supplied or mode-default locations use one Google Maps CID-resolution search plus one Local Services search. Use serpapi_google_local for ordinary nearby businesses such as restaurants or stores, and serpapi_maps_search for map-centered exploration.

query.description: Required Local Services profession such as plumber, electrician, HVAC, house cleaner, or car repair shop. Common natural phrases are normalized to SerpApi's supported category identifier. This is not a free-form business-name search.

data_cid.description: Optional numeric Google CID for a US city or district. Supplying it avoids the location resolver and uses one SerpApi search. Do not confuse it with the provider-level cid parameter.

location.description: Optional US city/district or ZIP used only when data_cid is omitted. New York, Austin, Portland, and their built-in ZIP aliases resolve locally; other locations consume an additional Google Maps SerpApi search. When omitted, Jarvis uses JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION and then JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE.

language.description: Optional two-letter result language such as en or es. Default en.

job_type.description: Optional provider-supported service subcategory such as restore_power for an electrician query.

cid.description: Provider cid from a prior result for focused provider details. Must be supplied together with bid and pid; this is different from data_cid.

bid.description: Provider bid from a prior result for focused provider details. Must be supplied together with cid and pid.

pid.description: Provider pid from a prior result for focused provider details. Must be supplied together with cid and bid.

max_results.description: Maximum normalized providers to return. Default 10.

no_cache.description: Bypass SerpApi's one-hour exact-parameter cache. Default false; cached searches are free. Applied to both calls when CID resolution is needed.

extra_params.description: Advanced non-reserved Google Local Services parameters passed through to SerpApi. Query, city CID, language, job type, provider IDs, cache, async, output, and trace controls cannot be overridden.

include_raw.description: Include the final full SerpApi JSON response for debugging. Default false.

availability.setup_hint: Set SERP_API_KEY in the active mode env file. For location-free prompts, also set JARVIS_DEFAULT_LOCATION or JARVIS_DEFAULT_POSTAL_CODE.
